gloss: character; letter (specialized reading, used in compounds for writing systems)

definitions.explanation: An alternative reading of 文字. Used in certain compounds and formal contexts.

examples.japanese: {象形文字|しょうけいもんじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{発展|はってん}した→発展する：03561_hatten⟧。
examples.notes: [Note: read here with the variant もんじ; しょうけいもじ is the more common reading]

examples.japanese: {楔形文字|くさびがたもんじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧メソポタミア⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{使|つか}われた→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Cuneiform was used in ancient Mesopotamia.
examples.notes: [Note: read here with the variant もんじ; くさびがたもじ is the more common reading]

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{文字|もんじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{読|よ}めない→読む：00426_yomu⟧。

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
{文字|もじ} is the standard reading, in compounds as well as alone. もんじ is an older reading. It survives in {一文字|いちもんじ} ('a straight line', as in {真一文字|まいちもんじ}) and as an accepted variant in a few terms for writing systems.

COMPOUNDS:
- {象形文字|しょうけいもんじ} (pictograph; usually read しょうけいもじ)
- {楔形文字|くさびがたもんじ} (cuneiform; usually くさびがたもじ)
- {表意文字|ひょういもんじ} (ideograph; usually ひょういもじ)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{文字|もじ}→文字：03632_moji⟧ (letter, character; the everyday reading)
